artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan extracting task.md's five non-default modes plus the Create Task worked-examples sub-region into six context/patterns files with imperative READ pointers, targeting ~66-69% body reduction; includes explicit merge-and-drop resolution of the Action Verb Categories keyword discrepancy, a mandated index-entries.json line_count phase, and a full-tier mode-executability audit.

memory_candidates.content: When extracting sections out of a markdown command/context file by heading boundary, a bare `grep -n '^## '` is unsafe: fenced code blocks and fenced output templates frequently contain lines that look like headings. In agent-system/extensions/core/commands/task.md, Review Mode's own fenced output template contains a '## Task Review: #{N}' line plus three '###' lines, so naive boundary detection truncates the mode at that decoy and silently drops ~209 lines. The safe procedure is: (1) derive a closed anchor set of the real headings by exact text rather than by pattern, (2) validate each candidate match is not inside a fence by computing ``` parity from line 1 to the match, and (3) perform multi-region extractions bottom-up (highest line number first) so untouched regions keep their line numbers, re-locating each boundary by heading text immediately before deletion. Pair this with a per-region verbatim diff check (capture region to a temp file before deleting, assert the destination file's post-preamble body is byte-identical) and a byte-ledger reconciliation, so content loss surfaces as an unexplained residual rather than passing silently.
